The test disks with Gaussian noise of sigma 12 (seed 7), 160 by 160 pixels, and the seed at 25 % of the width and 62.5 % of the height, the center of the largest disk. Brightness and 8 neighbors are the defaults. A small tolerance leaves noisy pixels out, so the region has holes. Once the tolerance covers the noise, the region is the disk, about 1590 pixels. The disk is 220 and the background 30, so when the tolerance nears that gap of 190, noisy background pixels start to match, and the region leaks into the background.
